question_ur: سیدھی لکیر 3x + 4y = 12 کی ڈھلان معلوم کریں۔
question_roman: Seedhi lakeer 3x + 4y = 12 ki dhalan maloom karen.
explanation_ur: لکیر کو ڈھلان والی صورت میں لکھیں تو 4y = -3x + 12 بنتا ہے، یعنی y = (-3/4)x + 3، اس لیے ڈھلان -3/4 ہے۔
explanation_roman: Lakeer ko dhalan wali soorat mein likhein to 4y = -3x + 12 banta hai, yani y = (-3/4)x + 3, is liye dhalan -3/4 hai.
subject: Past-Paper Topics (Reworded)
question: Find the slope of the line given by 3x + 4y = 12.
explanation: Rearranging into slope-intercept form gives 4y = -3x + 12, hence y = (-3/4)x + 3, so the slope is -3/4.
explanationEn: Rearranging into slope-intercept form gives 4y = -3x + 12, hence y = (-3/4)x + 3, so the slope is -3/4.
